definition_zh: n. 封锁；封锁部队；障碍物；v. 封锁；堵塞
definition_en: the sealing off of a place to stop goods or people moving in or out
core_image: 铁链横锁港口，商船尽数折返
scene: 海军舰队一字排开，铁链锁住了港湾出口。The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
sceneCN: 这里 blockade 是名词「封锁」（第 1 个义项：以武力切断往来）；句意是海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。

derivatives.zh: blockade 加 runner 的复合词，义为「突破封锁者」

senses.title: Sealing off a coast or port by force
senses.definition: the use of ships or troops to stop movement in or out of an area
senses.definitionCN: 以舰船或军队切断一地的进出
senses.example: The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
senses.exampleCN: 海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。
senses.why: A block is anything that stops movement; -ade makes the stopping into an action.
senses.whyCN: block 指一切阻隔之物，后缀 -ade 把阻隔化为行动。

senses.title: The force carrying out the blockade
senses.definition: the ships or troops stationed to enforce a blockade
senses.definitionCN: 驻守以执行封锁的舰船或部队
senses.example: The blockade seized three ships trying to slip out.
senses.exampleCN: 封锁部队截获了三艘试图溜出的船。
senses.why: The action names the actors who carry it out.
senses.whyCN: 行动之名转指执行行动之人。

senses.title: A physical barrier blocking a road
senses.definition: a barrier placed to block a road, street, or passage
senses.definitionCN: 阻断道路或通道的障碍物
senses.example: Protesters built a blockade of burning tyres.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议者用燃烧的轮胎筑起路障。
senses.why: Block in its concrete sense of a heavy mass supplies the object.
senses.whyCN: block 的「大块实体」本义提供了障碍之物象。

senses.title: Stopping supplies in war or dispute
senses.definition: cutting off food, fuel, or trade to force surrender
senses.definitionCN: 切断粮食、燃料或贸易以迫降
senses.example: The blockade starved the city into surrender.
senses.why: Sealing the exits seals the stomach; the siege logic is ancient.
senses.whyCN: 封住出口即封住肠胃，围困之理自古如此。

senses.title: A commercial embargo
senses.definition: a legal or political bar on trade with a place
senses.definitionCN: 对某地贸易的法律或政治禁阻
senses.example: The blockade on exports ruined the plantation economy.
senses.exampleCN: 出口封锁令种植园经济崩溃。
senses.why: Trade is traffic like any other; stopping it is a block in another lane.
senses.whyCN: 贸易亦如车流，禁断贸易即另一条车道上的阻隔。

senses.title: To seal off with a blockade
senses.definition: to surround a place with forces so nothing passes
senses.definitionCN: 以兵力围困一地使其无法通行
senses.example: Rebel forces blockaded the capital for months.
senses.exampleCN: 叛军对首都实施了数月封锁。
senses.why: The noun made a verb, as actions so often become commands.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词，行动之名变为行动之令。

senses.title: To obstruct passage or progress
senses.definition: to block movement, plans, or negotiation
senses.example: Medical aid was blockaded at the border.
senses.why: Any stopping wall, of steel or of rules, is a block.
senses.whyCN: 无论是钢铁还是规章，凡阻隔之墙皆为 block。

senses.title: A physiological blockage
senses.definition: a medical stoppage, such as a nerve or vessel block
senses.definitionCN: 神经或血管等在医学上的阻断
senses.example: A nerve blockade relieved the surgical pain.
senses.exampleCN: 神经阻滞缓解了术后疼痛。
senses.why: The body has its own roads; stopping one is a block of the same kind.
senses.whyCN: 身体自有道路，阻断其一即为同义之 block。

intro.en: Blockade is block plus the French noun suffix -ade.
intro.cn: blockade 由 block 加法语名词后缀 -ade 构成。

items.en: bloc meant a log or mass, source of English block.
items.cn: 古法语 bloc 意为「圆木、大块」，是英语 block 的来源。

items.en: the French word may come from Dutch blok, a trunk or mass.
items.cn: 法语词或出自荷兰语 blok「树干、大块」。

items.en: bloquate or blockade appeared in 17th-century French naval language for sealing a coast.
items.cn: 17 世纪法国海军用语中出现 bloquate／blockade，指封锁海岸。

items.en: English took blockade in the 17th century during naval wars.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪海战期间借入 blockade。

items.en: now covers military, civil, and even medical blocking.
items.cn: 今涵盖军事、民事乃至医学的阻断之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the block root; the near-meaning group gathers siege words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 block 词根；近义组收围困类词。

entries.definition: a thing that blocks a pipe or passage
a ship that evades a blockade
entries.definitionCN: 突破封锁者——同根复合词

entries.definition: surrounding and attacking a fortified place
a line of guards sealing an area

normalIntro.en: Blockade is block plus -ade, the act of blocking a whole place.
normalIntro.cn: blockade 即 block 加 -ade，对整个地方实施阻隔。

normal.en: The verb form blockades in the third person, past blockaded.
normal.cn: 动词三单 blockades，过去式 blockaded。

normal.en: Lift, impose, and run all pair with blockade.
normal.cn: lift、impose、run 都可与 blockade 搭配。

normal.en: Barricade is a road block; blockade seals a whole area.
normal.cn: barricade 是路障，blockade 封锁整个区域。

normal.en: It is a standard word in war reporting.
normal.cn: 它是战争报道的常用词。

normal.en: Medicine borrowed it for nerve blocks.

abstract.en: See a chain of grey warships around a harbour mouth.
abstract.cn: 看环绕港湾的灰色军舰锁链。

abstract.en: Feel a market with shelves bare of imports.
abstract.cn: 感受货架上空空如也的市场。

abstract.en: Picture burning tyres steaming across a highway.
abstract.cn: 想象高速路上冒烟的燃烧轮胎。

examples.en: The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
examples.cn: 海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。

examples.en: The blockade starved the city into surrender.
Medical aid was blockaded at the border.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不 Lapkeid」不好记？直接拆：block（堵）+ ade（行动）——把整个港口「堵」起来便是封锁。

root: block（经古法语 bloc，或出自荷兰语 blok「大块、圆木」）加法语名词后缀 -ade（表行动）；17 世纪经法国海军用语进入英语，义为「以武力封闭一地」，后扩指一切阻断行为。

sensesIntro.en: From chained harbours to barred borders to blocked nerves, blockade is the sealing of any road of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 从锁链封锁的港湾到受阻的边境再到被阻滞的神经，blockade 指对一切生命通道的封闭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chain of warships sealing a harbour mouth
core.cn: 核心意象：锁住港湾口的军舰锁链

branches.en: Military sealing of coasts and cities
branches.cn: 对海岸与城市的军事封锁

intro.en: The -ade suffix turns a block into a campaign.
intro.cn: -ade 后缀把「阻隔」化为一场行动。

latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根 block 经法语后缀组合。
